sources.title: Luwanga-English Dictionary
sources.citation: Anangwe, Alfred and Michael R. Marlo. 2008. Luwanga-English Dictionary, preliminary draft.
sources.rights_holder: Alfred Anangwe and Michael R. Marlo
sources.notes: Approximately 4,000 words is a project-description estimate. The draft says it was entered electronically by Anangwe and edited by Marlo in January 2008. Project provenance: https://www.riskinfo.ai/post/project-tafsiri-bridging-indigenous-languages-and-ai

versions.notes: The evidence supports January 2008 but not an exact day, so publication_date is intentionally unset.

rights.rights_holder: Alfred Anangwe and Michael R. Marlo
rights.evidence_reference: Public draft linked by the AbaWanga Kingdom site; no open license identified.
rights.notes: Public accessibility is not treated as permission for redistribution or training.

dialect_mappings.rationale: The dictionary identifies its language as Luwanga and public supporting descriptions relate Wanga to Luwanga; formal linguistic authority review remains pending.

sources.rights_holder: Michael R. Marlo, Adrian Sifuna, and Aggrey Wasike
sources.notes: The accessible draft is dated 2008-09-01; Glottolog also catalogs a 2007 manuscript. Approximately 6,200 words is a public project-description estimate.
